cache_comparison.accounting_note: logical serialized payload only; excludes Python object, dict, allocator, and process overhead; answer charged as one byte

verified_hash_source_replay.scope: exact for the fixed parent and the proved-injective history-to-residual map; a generic cache must retain or regenerate enough source data to verify full residual equality

delayed_history_audit.interpretation: same current SAT bit does not certify interchangeable residual state; a later restriction can expose a tag clause hidden by that bit

family_verification.distinctness_reason: each history tag selects the sign of its own disjoint 2-clause; control selects the even/odd XOR core

limitations: bounded chosen-input search, not an asymptotic collision lower bound
truncated SHA-256 is treated empirically as a digest map; no random-oracle theorem is assumed
syntactic normalization renames variables but is not graph-isomorphism or semantic canonicalization
logical payload counters exclude interpreter and hash-table implementation overhead
known SAT answers use the proved structure of this finite family, not a general SAT solver
